findings.title: Summary absence is presented as proof of independent tool calls
findings.what: The independence gate searches only `entry.summary`, but the provenance and detail call that value the earlier call's “result” and assert that the surviving count is a lower bound of calls that did not depend on it. A timeline summary may omit or truncate a path that existed in the actual tool result; textual absence from that summary therefore cannot establish independence. Each such false survivor also receives a fixed two-second reclaimed-time credit.
findings.fix: Either gate against a completeness-guaranteed result field, or relabel the metric as a summary-based heuristic and remove the lower-bound, proven-independence, avoidable-round-trip, and guaranteed reclaimed-time claims.
findings.acceptance: A fixture where the actual prior result contains the later path but its summary omits that path must not increment `independent` or `estTimeReclaimedMin`; alternatively, emitted copy and provenance must explicitly describe the result as an incomplete summary and make no lower-bound or proven-dependency claim.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed that line 178 is the sole stored result text, sourced from `entry.summary`; lines 283 and 310-313 nevertheless describe the full earlier result and a lower bound. No complete-result check appears in the dispatched file.

findings.title: Wall-clock buckets can exceed the measured runtime they claim to attribute
findings.what: Serial timeline gaps are summed independently, then subtracted from active runtime with `Math.max(0, ...)`. When serial gaps exceed active runtime, the excess is retained in `serialToolMs` while `modelWorkingMs` stops at zero. The test supplies 20 minutes of active turns and 24 minutes of serial gaps plus 16 minutes idle, so the detector reports 40 minutes “of measured wall-clock” from 36 minutes of runtime turns. This also incorrectly selects serial tools as dominant and recommends batching without proving the gaps are independent.
findings.fix: Join tool gaps to their containing active turns and cap or union their duration so `modelWorkingMs + serialToolMs` never exceeds active runtime; treat unmatched/overlapping gaps as separate diagnostic evidence rather than an attributed bucket. Do not label gaps independent without an independence signal.
findings.acceptance: For the existing fixture, attributed total must equal the 36-minute runtime total, all buckets must be non-negative and non-overlapping, and a regression assertion must enforce `modelWorkingMs + idleMs + serialToolMs <= sum(valid runtime turn durations)`.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial arithmetic re-derived the fixture: active runtime is 12m + 8m = 20m, idle is 16m, and timeline gaps are 9m + 8m + 7m = 24m. Lines 182 and 271-280 consequently produce 0m + 16m + 24m = 40m, exceeding the 36m measured runtime; the test explicitly expects these component values.
